predeclared_algorithm.reconnaissance: run the existing stateful SPP implementation chronologically over every raw epoch using the existing raw/nav corrections
predeclared_algorithm.eligible_anchor: finite valid SPP position with norm>1e6, at least four satellites, finite GDOP, and finite nonnegative pre-QC residual RMS
ranking: ascending pre-QC pseudorange residual RMS divided by configured pseudorange sigma
ascending input epoch index (deterministic time tie-break)
predeclared_algorithm.replay: reset an identical SPP processor, process the selected anchor first with its reconnaissance ECEF position as the initial state, then process later epochs chronologically; independently reset and process the anchor first, then earlier epochs in reverse index order
predeclared_algorithm.merge: use backward replay seeds before the anchor and forward replay seeds at/after the anchor; preserve invalid epochs for the existing last-valid-seed policy
predeclared_algorithm.fallback: if no eligible anchor exists, reset and use the historical chronological pass; no synthetic coordinate is permitted
predeclared_algorithm.fgo: pass the replay seeds to the unchanged P/D/TDCP/IMU graph and unchanged numerical parameters
predeclared_algorithm.selection_authority: raw/nav-derived SPP count, geometry, and normalized residual only; no truth or score

safety_gates_before_truth: anchor is selected exactly once by the frozen lexicographic rule
reverse replay uses a reset state and explicit decreasing-time diagnostic; no negative-dt factor is constructed
every input epoch has deterministic forward/backward assignment or historical-seed fallback
finite Earth-surface seeds and unchanged factor counts/model are required
three route-disjoint raw-only train structural runs pass deterministic repeat and physical continuity checks
Samsung initial settling/continuity must improve without a new >70 m/s isolated transition
fresh validation and holdout remain sealed until structural and already-opened-development gates pass

truth_access.phase30_samsung_truth: historical sealed diagnostic only; not reopened or used for this freeze

post_score_rule: no candidate parameter or source change after any development truth read; failed structural gate is a No-Go
